message.content: Verified the custom access log format and log locations, found that `burst=10` without `nodelay` delayed rather than rejected excess requests, added `nodelay` to `limit_req` in `/etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf`, reloaded Nginx (30 parallel requests then yielded 15×200/15×503), and confirmed all 9 requirements pass with the server live on localhost:8080.
